Sutura fibrosa que une o osso temporal a: Fibrous suture that unites the temporal bone to the parietal bone on each side.
É a articulação presente entre a fossa m: It is the joint present between the mandibular fossa and the articular tubercle of the temporal bone superiorly, and the head of the mandible inferiorly. It is a hinge-type synovial joint, which allows movements of flexion, extension, translation, and rotation.
Sutura fibrosa que une os ossos parietai: Fibrous suture that unites the parietal bones to the occipital bone.
Fibrous suture that unites the parietal bones to the frontal bone.
Sutura fibrosa que une os dois ossos par: Fibrous suture that unites the two parietal bones.
É uma faixa espessa que vai da patela at: It is a thick band that runs from the patella to the tibial tuberosity. It is tapped to elicit the patellar reflex.
Faixa espessa que vai da patela até a tu: Thick band that runs from the patella to the tibial tuberosity. It is tapped to elicit the patellar reflex.
É um disco fibrocartilagíneo existente e: It is a fibrocartilaginous disc existing between the articular surfaces of the tibia and the femur. It helps compose the joint between these two bones. It is also present on the lateral portion.
Os meniscos são estruturas fibrocartilag: The menisci are fibrocartilaginous structures that make up the intra-articular elements of the knee, along with the cruciate ligaments.
Consistem em discos articulares fibrocar: Consist of fibrocartilaginous articular discs that make up the intra-articular ligaments of the knee, along with the cruciate ligaments.
Articulação aberta, joelho em suave flex: Open joint, knee in slight flexion
É originado na área intercondilar anteri: It originates from the anterior intercondylar area of the tibia, immediately posterior to the attachment of the medial meniscus. The weaker of the cruciate ligaments, it is responsible for preventing posterior displacement of the femur on the tibia and hyperextension of the knee joint.
É originado da área intercondilar poster: It originates from the posterior intercondylar area of the tibia and runs superiorly and anteriorly on the medial side of the ACL to attach anteriorly. It prevents anterior displacement of the femur on the tibia or posterior displacement of the tibia on the femur and helps prevent hyperflexion of the knee joint. Therefore, it is considered the main stabilizing factor of the femur.
Membrana de tecido conjuntivo denso que: Membrane of dense connective tissue that extends between the tibia and fibula.
É uma articulação entre os corpos dos os: It is a joint between the bodies of the pubic bones, where the interposed tissue is fibrous cartilage. It is related to pregnancy through the obstetric conjugate, which is the diameter of the smallest distance through which the fetal head must pass, and which goes from the sacral promontory to the inferior margin of the pubic symphysis.
Esse ligamento, assim como o trato iliop: This ligament, as well as the iliopubic tract, extends from the anterior superior iliac spine to the pubic tubercle. Both cover an area of innate weakness in the abdominal wall, where inguinal hernias frequently occur.
Os ligamentos iliofemoral, isquifemoral: The iliofemoral, ischiofemoral, and pubofemoral ligaments contribute to its formation.
Ligamento da Cabeça do Fêmur: Ligament of the Head of the Femur
Prega sinovial relativamente fraca e de: Relatively weak synovial fold of little importance to the hip joint.
É uma articulação sinovial do tipo esfer: It is a triaxial, spheroidal-type synovial joint between the head of the femur and the acetabular fossa of the hip bone.
Entre as epífises distais da tíbia e da: Between the distal epiphyses of the tibia and fibula and the trochlea of the talus (synovial hinge).
Entre as faces articulares do tálus e ca: Between the articular surfaces of the talus and calcaneus, part of the talocalcaneonavicular joint.
Entre cuneiformes/cuboide e as bases do: Between cuneiforms/cuboid and the bases of the metatarsals (synovial plane).
Entre a cabeça do metatarso e as falange: Between the head of the metatarsal and the proximal phalanges (synovial ellipsoid).
Entre a cabeça proximal e a base da fala: Between the proximal head and the base of the middle phalanx (synovial hinge).
Entre a face articular do calcâneo do tá: Between the calcaneal articular surface of the talus, the posterior articular surface on the navicular, and the talar surface of the calcaneus.
Entre a face articular cubóidea do calcâ: Between the cuboid articular surface of the calcaneus and the posterior surface of the cuboid.
É um espessamento da membrana fibrosa da: It is a thickening of the fibrous membrane of the medial and triangular articular capsule, extending from the medial epicondyle of the humerus to the coronoid process and olecranon of the ulna. It consists of 3 bands: anterior, posterior, and oblique.
It is a fan-like thickening of the fibrous membrane of the articular capsule, extending from the lateral epicondyle of the humerus and blending distally with the anular ligament of the radius.
É uma articulação sinovial do tipo gíngl: It is a hinge-type synovial joint, which performs flexion and extension movements and is located 2 to 3 centimeters inferior to the epicondyles of the humerus. In it, the trochlea articulates with the trochlear notch of the ulna, and the capitulum articulates with the superior surface of the head of the radius, constituting the humeroulnar and humeroradial joints, respectively.
Localizada entre a cabeça da ulna e inci: Located between the head of the ulna and the ulnar notch at the distal end of the radius, it is a trochoid-type synovial joint that performs pronation and supination movements.
É uma articulação sinovial do tipo elips: It is an ellipsoid-type synovial joint, which performs flexion, extension, adduction, and abduction movements. The carpal articular surface of the radius articulates with the bones of the proximal carpal row (scaphoid, lunate).
Articulação Carpometacarpal do Polegar (: Carpometacarpal Joint of Thumb (between the trapezium bone and the first metacarpal)
É uma articulação sinovial do tipo plana: It is a plane-type synovial joint that performs the specific movements of the thumb (digit I).
Passagem profunda ao retináculo dos músc: Passage deep to the flexor retinaculum, bounded laterally by the tubercles of the scaphoid and trapezium bones and medially by the pisiform bone and the hook of the hamate bone, through which the median nerve passes. Compression of the median nerve in the carpal tunnel, mainly caused by repetitive strain injuries, is known as carpal tunnel syndrome and causes numbness and tingling.
São articulações sinoviais do tipo elips: These are ellipsoid-type synovial joints that perform flexion and extension, abduction, and adduction movements.
São articulações sinoviais do tipo gíngl: These are hinge-type synovial joints that perform flexion and extension movements.
These are hinge-type synovial joints that perform flexion and extension movements.
Articulação sinovial do tipo gínglimo qu: Hinge-type synovial joint that performs flexion and extension movements.
Articulação sinovial do tipo elipsoide q: Ellipsoid-type synovial joint that performs flexion, extension, abduction, and adduction movements.
Estrutura fibrocartilagínea e anular que: A fibrocartilaginous, ring-like structure that helps to slightly deepen the glenoid cavity, aiding in the attachment of the humerus.
É uma articulação sinovial do tipo esfer: It is a spheroidal (triaxial) type synovial joint that allows a wide range of motion, which also makes it unstable. The head of the humerus articulates with the glenoid cavity of the scapula, being held in this cavity by the tone of the musculotendinous rotator cuff muscles.
Um processo da escápula que serve como l: A process of the scapula that serves as an attachment site for important ligaments in the glenohumeral joint, such as the coracoacromial ligament, the coracohumeral ligament, and the coracoclavicular ligament.
Estrutura que serve como local de inserç: A structure that serves as an attachment site for important ligaments for the glenohumeral joint, such as the acromioclavicular ligament and the coracoacromial ligament.
Ligamento que une o processo coracoide a: Ligament that connects the coracoid process to the acromion and forms the coracoacromial arch, a protective structure located over the head of the humerus, preventing its superior dislocation from the glenoid cavity.
É uma articulação do tipo sínfise, desti: It is a symphysis-type joint, designed for strength and weight-bearing. The articular surfaces of adjacent vertebrae are united by intervertebral discs; by the anterior longitudinal ligament, which covers and unites the anterolateral faces of the vertebral bodies and intervertebral discs; and by the posterior longitudinal ligament, which runs within the vertebral canal along the posterior face of the vertebral bodies.
São articulações sinoviais planas entre: These are plane synovial joints between the superior and inferior articular processes of adjacent vertebrae. Each joint is surrounded by a thin articular capsule, which is thinner and looser in the cervical region, reflecting the large range of motion. The capsule is attached to the margins of the articular surfaces of the articular processes of adjacent vertebrae. Accessory ligaments unite laminae, spinous processes, and transverse processes, aiding in stabilization.
Unem os corpos vertebrais em uma coluna: They unite the vertebral bodies into a semi-rigid and continuous vertebral column, allowing movement and helping absorb impacts. They consist of an anulus fibrosus formed by concentric lamellae of fibrocartilage that form the circumference of the disc, and a central, semi-liquid nucleus pulposus. There is no intervertebral disc between C1 and C2.
Entre a face articular do tubérculo da c: Between the articular facet of the rib tubercle and the costal facet of the transverse process. The articular capsules are loose and reinforced by several ligaments. They are absent in the XI and XII ribs.
A cabeça da costela articula-se com a fó: The head of the rib articulates with the superior costal facet of the vertebra below and with the inferior costal facet of the vertebra above.
Articula-se com a extremidade esternal d: Articulates with the sternal end of the clavicle, forming the sternoclavicular joint (spheroidal synovial joint with an articular disc).
Entre a cartilagem costal e a costela. A: Between the costal cartilage and the rib. The costochondral joints are synchondroses.
São as articulações entre o esterno e as: These are the joints between the sternum and the costal cartilages. The first pair of costal cartilages articulates with the manubrium, forming the synchondrosis of the first rib. From the second to the seventh pair of costal cartilages, the articulation is synovial. The weak articular capsules of these joints have an anterior and posterior thickening, which form the radiate sternocostal ligaments.
Sincondrose temporária, geralmente ossif: Temporary synchondrosis, usually ossified in adults.
Articula-se com a clavícula, formando a: Articulates with the clavicle, forming the sternoclavicular joint, which is synovial, spheroidal, and triaxial.
